method: Three no-driver release-binary launches, 10 seconds each. Fresh process, warm filesystem caches. Mac locked; first WebKit process is a startup proxy, not visible readiness. New WebKit subprocesses attributed by PID difference on this otherwise idle sample, not guaranteed parent ownership.
limitations: Fresh-process launches with warm filesystem caches; not cold-cache or visible-ready startup.
Mac locked: no production input/frame/VoiceOver observations.
Run independently of native desktop tests; final three samples have one newly spawned WebKit GPU/Networking/WebContent set each.
New WebKit processes attributed by PID difference, not authoritative ownership. RSS is not physical footprint; shared pages may be double counted.
Empty case screen, 10 seconds per run. Not a large-case stress or leak test.
